summary.text: Rebecca Winsor is the Democratic candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 75, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Walt Brooks.
An administrative assistant and St. George resident, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is focused on public education and government accountability.

paragraphs.text: Winsor earned a bachelor's degree from Western Governors University in 2017, and her career experience includes working as an administrative assistant, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign said she graduated from Delta High School, attended CEU and Southern Utah University, and raised five sons.

The survey said she ran for Washington County Commission Seat A in 2022, served on the board of the Washington County Democrats, and is a founding member and former spokesperson of the Washington County League of Women Voters.
It said she entered the District 75 race late because the previous candidate had to leave it.
Winsor's survey responses emphasized public education, including a call to repeal the Utah Fits All scholarship program and to fold charter schools into local school districts.
They also called for ending gerrymandering, expanding affordable housing, childcare and parental leave, and universal health care.
